# Nova — Sprint 11 Competitor Benchmark

**Scope:** Long-tail pages — Consent builder, AI Design gallery, Settings hub, Admin panel, Marketing hub, Inventory, Locations, Ink registry (EU REACH).
**Mission:** Lift the "pages that don't get love" to hero-page quality.

---

## 1. Consent templates builder (drag-drop)

**DocuSign Agreement Template Builder (2025 beta).** Upload DOCX/PDF, drag field types (signature, date, initial, textbox, checkbox, dropdown) from a right-side palette onto the canvas. Conditional logic hides/shows sections based on signer input. Templates save to a searchable **library** (single source of truth) with folders + tagging. Left nav = documents list; center = canvas; right = field/role palette. [DocuSign blog](https://www.docusign.com/blog/new-template-builder-in-docusign-streamlines-template-creation) · [Community post](https://community.docusign.com/what-s-new-at-docusign-156/docusign-s-new-agreement-template-builder-explained-20507)

**PandaDoc.** Two libraries: **template library** (1000+ whole docs) and **content library** (reusable blocks/snippets — pricing tables, clauses, sections). Drag a snippet into any doc. Editor uses a block model: each section = card with a drag handle, duplicate, delete. Live preview renders the signer view in a right rail. [PandaDoc e-sig](https://www.pandadoc.com/electronic-signature-software/) · [PandaDoc vs HelloSign](https://www.pandadoc.com/alternatives/hellosign/)

**Dropbox Sign (HelloSign).** Simpler. Pre-made template library, fillable PDF fields, mobile signing works without sign-up/login/download — signer opens link, taps, draws signature, done. [Dropbox Sign alternatives](https://www.pandadoc.com/blog/hellosign-alternatives/)

**Mobile signature capture.** Best-in-class: no account required, canvas fills 90% of viewport, "Draw / Type / Upload" tab switcher, haptic feedback on stroke end, auto-trim whitespace, re-do button, thick 3px stroke (not a thin squiggle). PandaDoc signs in seconds on any device.

**Takeaway for InkOS:** 3-column builder — left = template list + section library drawer (reusable blocks: "Allergy disclosure", "GDPR consent", "Aftercare", "Medical history"), center = canvas with block cards (drag handle, duplicate, delete), right = field inspector. Live preview as toggle, not split view (saves width). Mobile signer: full-screen canvas, Draw/Type tabs, 3px stroke, auto-trim.

---

## 2. AI Design gallery

**Midjourney gallery.** Masonry grid with variable-height tiles, infinite scroll, hover reveals prompt + "upscale/vary/download" action bar. Lightbox opens on click with metadata sidebar (prompt, seed, model, params). [Design+Code Midjourney masonry](https://designcode.io/midjourney-masonry-ui/)

**Figma Community / Notion covers.** Large preview thumbnails, hover = zoom + creator overlay, click = detail modal with "Use template" CTA. Grid uses `auto-fit minmax(280px, 1fr)` with consistent aspect ratio for scannability. [Notion Covers Figma](https://www.figma.com/community/file/1550223683069114661/notion-covers)

**Masonry + lightbox pattern.** Two components: CSS Grid masonry for layout, lightbox overlay for focused view. Common: click expands to full-screen blurred overlay, prev/next arrows, Esc closes, deep link via URL hash. [Next.js masonry + lightbox](https://www.fullstackfoundations.com/blog/nextjs-masonry-image-gallery-lightbox) · [Free Frontend masonry examples](https://freefrontend.com/css-masonry-layouts/)

**Public share link polish.** Watermark bottom-right (low-opacity studio mark), "Powered by InkOS" footer on public page, OG meta tags so link previews well on iMessage/Instagram DM, `?utm=share` tracking. Hide auth UI on `/share/[token]` routes.

**Takeaway for InkOS:** Masonry grid (3-col desktop, 2 tablet, 1 mobile), uniform 4:5 aspect, hover reveals prompt + Save/Regenerate/Share/Send-to-client. Lightbox with metadata sidebar (prompt, model, cost, commission link). Public share: clean, one-CTA ("Book this design"), watermark, "Powered by InkOS" footer.

---

## 3. Settings hub architecture

**Stripe Dashboard.** Sidebar nav, 3 functional zones: (1) payments/payouts/customers, (2) products/sales, (3) developers/logs. Settings live under Business Settings with left-rail sub-nav. Recent tabs auto-surface in sidebar to speed returns. [Stripe Web Dashboard](https://docs.stripe.com/dashboard/basics) · [Stripe Support Topics](https://support.stripe.com/topics/dashboard)

**Linear / Vercel pattern.** Two-level sidebar: top-level = area (Account, Workspace, Billing, Team, Integrations, Security), sub-nav reveals inside area. Breadcrumbs at top: `Settings / Workspace / Members`. [Vercel design guidelines](https://vercel.com/design/guidelines)

**Save-on-blur vs explicit save.** Best-in-class: **explicit save** on forms with multiple fields (avoids half-saved state + lets users cancel), **save-on-blur** for single toggles/selects (instant feedback, optimistic update, toast on confirm). Dirty-state guard: "You have unsaved changes" on nav away.

**Takeaway for InkOS:** Left sidebar with 6 groups — **Account** (profile, password, 2FA, sessions), **Studio** (name, logo, brand, slug, hours, locations), **Team** (members, roles, invites), **Billing** (plan, payment method, invoices), **Integrations** (Dodo, Resend, Sentry, PostHog, Google Cal), **Advanced** (ink registry link, audit log, data export, danger zone). Breadcrumb top-nav. Explicit Save button sticky at bottom on long forms. Toggles save-on-blur with toast.

---

## 4. Admin panel patterns

**Stripe Admin team pages.** Searchable user table with filters (role, last active, status), row click = detail drawer, bulk actions toolbar. Role-based permissions: Developer, Support Specialist, Admin. [Stripe new roles](https://stripe.com/blog/new-roles-and-permissions-in-the-dashboard) · [Stripe admin permissions](https://support.stripe.com/questions/administrative-account-permissions-and-updating-administrative-users)

**Connect-style platform admin.** Account list → row → detail page with tabs (Overview, Balance, Transfers, Activity). Impersonate surfaced as "View as" action on detail page (logs the event). [Stripe Connect platform controls](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/platform-controls-for-stripe-dashboard-accounts)

**Feature flags / announcements.** Table pattern: flag name, description, scope (global/studio/plan), rollout %, last modified, toggle. Announcements: markdown editor + target audience dropdown + schedule picker + preview panel.

**Takeaway for InkOS:** `/admin/studios` table — search by name/slug/email, filters (plan, status, created date), row = studio with plan badge + MRR + artist count. Row actions: Impersonate (banner shows "Impersonating X — exit"), Ban/Unban (confirm + reason), GDPR export (async, emails ZIP when ready), Delete (30-day soft-delete). `/admin/system` — feature flags CRUD table + announcement composer with target audience + preview. Every admin action → audit log.

---

## 5. Marketing hub

**Mailchimp Regular campaign flow.** Linear wizard, 4 steps visible in top stepper: **Audience → Setup → Design → Confirm**. Each step commits before next. Content builder = block-based drag-drop. Auto-post to Instagram/Facebook/X at send time. [Mailchimp getting started](https://mailchimp.com/help/getting-started-with-campaigns/) · [Mailchimp schedule](https://mailchimp.com/resources/schedule-your-content/)

**Klaviyo Omnichannel Campaign Builder.** Audience filters first (segments), then channel mix (email + SMS + push), then content per channel, then schedule. Flow trigger options: list, segment, metric, price drop, date property — the 5 triggers cover every re-engagement case. AI-assisted segment creation ("Define with AI" → describe audience in plain English). [Klaviyo omnichannel builder](https://www.klaviyo.com/blog/omnichannel-campaign-builder) · [Klaviyo flows](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002774932) · [Klaviyo Segments AI](https://www.klaviyo.com/blog/segments-ai)

**Customer.io.** Similar audience→channel→content→schedule pattern, stronger event-triggered flows.

**Takeaway for InkOS:** Wizard with 4 steps — **Audience** (all clients, segment chip picker: "inactive 90d", "birthday this month", "completed 1+ tattoo"), **Channel** (Email / SMS toggle — Resend for email, future SMS), **Content** (block editor: hero image, headline, body, CTA button → Book), **Schedule** (Send now / Schedule / Recurring). Top stepper. Preview panel right side. Segment picker uses pre-built InkOS-native segments (no need for custom query builder in v1).

---

## 6. Inventory management

**Square for Retail.** Built-in iPhone/iPad camera scanning OR compatible Bluetooth scanner. Cycle counts (partial stocktakes) from mobile. [Square community](https://community.squareup.com/t5/Questions-How-To/Best-App-for-Inventory/m-p/394480)

**Shopify + Stocky.** Full stocktake = scan each item, system shows expected qty, artist enters actual, variance logged. Requires HID-mode scanner. Barcode scans add to POS cart; stocktake needs Stocky app. Scan via POS Go camera or phone camera. [Shopify stocktakes](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/sell-in-person/shopify-pos/inventory-management/stocky/inventory-management/stocktakes) · [Shopify barcode guide](https://www.shopify.com/blog/barcode-inventory-management)

**Lightspeed / Shopventory.** Cycle count software with depletion charts (usage/week), reorder point alerts, COGS tracked per SKU. [Shopventory cycle count](https://shopventory.com/cycle-count-software-system/)

**Takeaway for InkOS:** Stocktake mode = full-screen "Scanning" UI, large input (auto-focused, accepts USB HID scanner wedge input OR camera fallback via `getUserMedia` + ZXing). Each scan: flash green, item name + expected qty + actual qty input, running variance counter top-right. Depletion chart on item detail (units/week trend). COGS auto-updated from last PO. Reorder alerts when below threshold.

---

## 7. Locations management

**Fresha.** Each location configured independently — schedules, team, services, reports, product sales. Location switcher top-bar on desktop + mobile. Per-location opening hours via Workspace settings. [Fresha workspace](https://www.fresha.com/help-center/knowledge-base/workspace-settings) · [Fresha create locations](https://www.fresha.com/help-center/knowledge-base/workspace-settings/42-create-and-manage-business-locations) · [Fresha multi-location blog](https://www.fresha.com/blog/easy-ways-to-manage-multiple-locations)

**Mindbody.** Central pricing/services with per-location overrides. "Make changes once, see implemented across locations" + "adjust by location when needed." [Mindbody multi-location](https://www.mindbodyonline.com/business/multi-location-management)

**Takeaway for InkOS:** `/settings/locations` — card grid, each card = location with map thumbnail (Mapbox static image), name, address, hours summary, active/inactive toggle. Click → detail page with tabs: **Details** (name, address w/ autocomplete, phone, photos), **Hours** (7-row grid with open/close time + "Closed" toggle per day + holiday overrides), **Team** (artists assigned), **Services** (inherit from studio OR override pricing/duration per location). Location switcher = app-shell top-bar dropdown with "All locations" option for owners.

---

## 8. Ink registry (EU REACH)

**The pattern (InkBase + studio-level tracking).** Each ink bottle registered with brand, line, color, batch/lot, manufacture date, expiry, REACH compliance status, SDS link. Client logs link bottle → client session → date. Passport = printable PDF given to client on request; log surfaces when client books again with same ink. [Karger study (InkBase)](https://karger.com/drm/article/241/3/259/918964/Tattoo-Ink-Products-and-Pigments-2018-2019-Upfront) · [Intenze REACH guide](https://intenzetattooink.com/pages/understanding-reach-compliance-in-the-tattoo-industry) · [Magnum Tattoo REACH](https://www.magnumtattoosupplies.co.uk/blogs/article/what-every-tattoo-artist-needs-to-know-about-eu-reach-compliant-inks)

**SDS-driven.** Safety Data Sheets from manufacturer must include SVHC status. 4000+ chemicals banned under 2022 regulation — software must flag non-compliant inks loudly.

**Takeaway for InkOS:** `/settings/ink-registry` — table of ink bottles (brand, line, color swatch, batch, expiry, REACH status badge — green/amber/red, SDS link). Add ink form: brand autocomplete, line, color (swatch picker), batch/lot, manufacture date, expiry date, REACH-compliant toggle + SDS upload. 3-column layout: left nav = template list (searchable, folders), center = canvas where blocks stack vertically (each block = card with drag-handle on left edge, ⋮ menu top-right for duplicate/delete), right rail = **Section Library** drawer with pre-built reusable blocks (InkOS ships: Allergy Disclosure, GDPR Consent, Medical History, Aftercare, Photo Release, Minor Consent).
